notes: Accept, with ten locator page numbers corrected. The recorded hash of the authors' PDF reproduces (2e425ee6…) and I re-extracted all 31 pages, whose printed numbers coincide with the PDF's. Structure: 150 items (131 missing, 12 planned, 7 library), every missing item routed exactly once, all fourteen routes' stages exist, all planned layer ids exist, both Part II parents exist with titles the proposals reproduce exactly, both areas are galaxy ids, and check_paper.py passes; the planned items named inside source routes are the provision of PROTOCOL §16. All nine declarations behind the seven library items resolve at the pins, including Tau Ceti's torus and multiplicative-type Hopf-algebra properties, the geometric character group, IsProPSylow with its existence theorem, and Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle and AddCommGrpCat.injective_of_divisible. Coverage is complete: all 39 numbered results of the paper are cited by items. The correction is to the page numbers. Ten citations name a result one page away from where the paper declares it — Proposition 2.3 is on p.9 and was cited at p.8 in four items, Proposition 2.6 is on p.11 (cited p.10), Corollaire 2.2 on p.8 (cited p.7), Corollaire 3.2 on p.13 (cited p.14), Théorème 4.2 on p.16 (cited p.15 twice) and Définition 6.4 on p.22 (cited p.23). I checked each declaration on the page and corrected the numbers; the two 'proof of' locators that also differ (Theorem 2.1 at p.11, Theorem 4.2 at p.17) are right as they stand, and the two citations of 'DLA19 Definition 5.1 p.22' are external and untouched. Both findings are confirmed. E1 is a gap in a stated result: the standing setting of §4 on p.15 fixes a dominant f : X → P^n whose generic fibre is rationally connected, and Remarque 4.5 on p.17 invokes Théorème 4.2(i) for an X assumed only proper and smooth. E2 is printed as quoted on p.4, and the generalised quaternion group Q_{2^m} is defined for m ≥ 3. Nothing was rejected or deleted and I add no finding: I read §§1–4 and 6 around the findings and the statements the routes cite, not all 31 pages line by line.
